# SYS009: sys-flow-end-unbound

> Generated: do not edit this page. Regenerate with `cargo dev gen rules`.

| version | 1 |
| since | 2.0.0 |

One end of a flow binds no code while the other does.

Fires when a flow's producer or consumer end has no row at all, the endpoint node owns code and the other end is not empty too (then it is SYS004). Unresolved when the end holds only May rows or hidden placeholders, or asked for pack inference that cannot run yet.

## Examples

### SYS009 sys-flow-end-unbound / A flow end with no code beside a bound end fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted { owns "a/**"; }
node b : trusted { owns "b/**"; }
node d : trusted { owns "design/**"; }
flow half : a -> b {
  producer "a/lib.rs::send";
  consumer "b/lib.rs::absent";
}
=== a/lib.rs
pub fn send() {}
=== b/lib.rs
pub fn recv() {}
```

### SYS009 sys-flow-end-unbound / A flow with both ends bound is clean #2 (line 24) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node a : trusted { owns "a/**"; }
node b : trusted { owns "b/**"; }
node d : trusted { owns "design/**"; }
flow ok : a -> b {

  consumer "b/lib.rs::recv";

=== b/lib.rs
```
